Title: Sparse Retrieval Improves Long-Context Question Answering
URL: https://preprints.example/abs/2210.04417

Abstract. We study whether adding a sparse lexical retriever in front of a long-context
language model improves question answering over documents longer than 100k tokens.
Across four benchmarks, retrieval-augmented prompting improves exact-match accuracy by
12% on average relative to placing the full document in context, while reducing
inference cost by 70%. Gains are largest for multi-hop questions.
